categories.main_business_segments: Iljin Display Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: the Sapphire business division, which manufactures sapphire wafers used as substrates for LEDs, and the Touch business division, which produces touch screen panels for devices such as smartphones, tablets, automotive electronics, and notebook PCs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technology, specifically the Kyropoulos method, to produce high-quality sapphire single crystals at temperatures above 2050°C. Sapphire wafers are precision-cut and polished to serve as substrates for GaN epitaxial LED chips. The touch screen panels mainly use capacitive sensing technology, including mutual capacitance methods with electrode arrays, enabling multi-touch and pressure-sensitive (Force Touch) functionalities. The company also develops flexible display touch solutions using new materials like Ag nanowires and metal mesh.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Iljin Display serves LED chip manufacturers, display panel producers, and electronic device manufacturers in industries such as consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, notebooks), automotive electronics, and emerging wearable display markets like VR and AR. Its sapphire wafers are used in LED lighting, backlight units for TVs and mobile devices, and are expanding into micro-LED displays. The touch panels are supplied to smartphone, tablet, automotive, and PC manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in South Korea (Chungbuk and Gyeonggi provinces) and Vietnam. Its sales markets include domestic South Korea, Vietnam, China, Malaysia, the United States, Germany, and Taiwan, with significant export sales particularly to Vietnam and other Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Iljin Display operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the supply chain by producing key materials and components such as sapphire wafers and touch screen panels, which are then supplied to downstream manufacturers of LED chips and electronic devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on R&D to enhance sapphire crystal growth and wafer polishing technologies, develop next-generation LED substrates including micro-LED applications, and innovate touch screen technologies such as Force Touch, fingerprint recognition modules, flexible displays, and OLED-compatible touch panels. It invests in productivity improvements, cost reduction, and new product development aligned with emerging display technologies and market needs.
categories.revenue_model: Iljin Display generates revenue primarily through product sales of sapphire wafers and touch screen panels. Sales are conducted via direct shipments to customers, with payment terms typically involving post-shipment payment within 60 days. The company also engages in export sales to global customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic and global supplier of sapphire substrates for LEDs and advanced touch screen panels. It competes in a market characterized by intense competition and supply chain restructuring, maintaining competitiveness through proprietary crystal growth technology and expanding market share in Europe, the Americas, and Taiwan. It is recognized as a specialized LED material supplier with growing presence in next-generation display markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Iljin Display reported consolidated revenues of approximately 54.3 billion KRW, a significant decline from the previous year’s 124.3 billion KRW, with an operating loss of about 8 billion KRW and a net loss of approximately 15 billion KRW. The company’s total assets stood at around 111.9 billion KRW with a high debt-to-equity ratio of 338.78%, reflecting financial challenges and a contraction in sales, particularly in the touch panel segment. Despite recent setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Iljin Display emphasizes its unique value through domestically developed advanced sapphire crystal growth technology, enabling high-quality LED substrates that improve LED chip efficiency and yield. Its touch screen products incorporate innovative features like Force Touch and integrated fingerprint sensors, catering to evolving user interface demands. The company’s focus on quality, technological innovation, and responsiveness to emerging display trends such as micro-LED and flexible displays differentiates it in competitive global markets.
